attempts.summary: Configured daily log rotation for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 via /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app (daily, rotate 7, compress, copytruncate) so the application keeps writing to the same file after rotation. Verified via a forced rotation that old content compresses to app.log.1.gz, app.log truncates to 0 bytes in place, and writes continue post-rotation. Restored original log content afterward. Completed the mandatory node1 restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual reboot), and verified logrotate.timer active/enabled plus the rotation config and log content all recovered intact.
